team.page.heading: Working together
team.page.on: Work on this project with others
team.page.folder_missing: This folder is not there. Check that its drive or sync app is connected, or choose it again.

team.refused.too_large: That is too large to send in one message.
team.refused.no_device: This computer has no keys for Working together yet.

team.refused.kind_not_allowed: That message is one only the lead may send, so it was refused.
team.refused.no_key: This computer has no key for that message.
team.refused.bad_words: Those are not the twelve words of an invite. Check each word, or paste the link.
team.refused.no_name: Say your name, as the others will see it.

team.refused.blob_not_here: That file has not reached the shared folder on this computer yet.

team.history.on_relay: Working together turned on by {name}, sending through the relay.
team.history.on_folder: Working together turned on by {name}, sending through a shared folder.

team.history.removed: {name} removed. The project's key changed, so {name} gets nothing new.

team.cli.off: Working together is off in this project.
team.cli.on: Working together is on, sending through {route}.
team.cli.recordings_off: The recordings stay on this computer.
team.cli.invite_made: Invite made, open until {expires}. Send the link by email, or read the words out. It works once.
team.cli.answered: {name} has answered. Check code: {code}. Read it to each other on a call, then run team admit with --match or --differ.
team.cli.join_code: Check code: {code}. Read it to {name} on a call. Once they say it matches, run team joined with --invite {invite}.
team.cli.joined: Joined. The project's key is on this computer.
team.cli.not_joined: Not joined yet: the lead has not said the check codes match.
team.cli.needs_code: Not on the relay yet: run team set --code-stdin with the relay code.
team.cli.agent_relay: The relay needs a relay code, which is his to type. Ask him to turn Working together on in Project settings, or use route folder.
team.cli.code_held: A relay code is typed in Project settings, or run this with Dangerously skip permissions on. Nothing changed.
team.cli.no_remove: Say who to remove by name, or one computer with --computer and its id from team show.
team.cli.removed: You are no longer on this project's list. Nothing new comes to this computer.
